column1: # F4-03: F4 failures judged and kept, each with its reason. Read by validate.py. A part
# whose every message a row explains reports `recorded`, and does not fail the deck;
# anything else in that part does. --no-known reports them as failures.
# Columns, tab-separated: deck glob, part glob, message regex, kind, reason.
#   fixture-invalid  Invalid on purpose or by construction, to test retention.
#   not-powerpoint   Claims a Strict namespace but carries Transitional values, which does
#                    not look saved by PowerPoint (STRICT-02), so Strict is not relaxed for it.

notesMaster with no cSld, written by the generator; the fixture tests properties, not masters
handoutMaster with no cSld; as notesMaster
